actions.name: Wild Shape
actions.desc: Bonus action: become a beast you have seen; its HP soak damage first

1.name: Druidic
1.desc: You know Druidic and can leave hidden messages in it (DC 15 Perception to notice, magic to read).

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: WIS spellcaster preparing WIS mod + druid level spells from the druid list each long rest; druidic focus; rituals you prepared.

2.name: Wild Shape
2.desc: Action: become a beast you have seen (CR 1/4, no fly or swim at 2nd; CR 1/2 no fly at 4th; CR 1 at 8th) for half your level in hours; 2 uses per short rest; its HP soak damage first.

4.name: Wild Shape improvement
4.desc: Wild Shape allows tougher beasts: CR 1/2 without flying at 4th level, CR 1 at 8th.

8.name: Wild Shape improvement
8.desc: Wild Shape allows tougher beasts: CR 1/2 without flying at 4th level, CR 1 at 8th.

18.name: Timeless Body
18.desc: You age one year every ten.

18.name: Beast Spells
18.desc: Cast druid spells in Wild Shape (verbal and somatic only, no material).

20.name: Archdruid
20.desc: Unlimited Wild Shape; ignore verbal, somatic and free non-consumed material components of druid spells.

2.name: Balm of the Summer Court
2.desc: Pool of d6s equal to druid level: bonus action, spend up to half your level of them to heal an ally within 120 ft, plus 1 temp HP per die; long rest.

6.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
6.desc: During a rest, a 30 ft sphere gives +5 Stealth and Perception and hides your fire's light.

10.name: Hidden Paths
10.desc: Bonus action: teleport 60 ft, or action: teleport a willing touched creature 30 ft; WIS mod uses per long rest.

14.name: Walker in Dreams
14.desc: After a short rest, cast Dream, Scrying or a Teleportation Circle back to your last long rest spot, no slot or material; once per long rest.

2.name: Natural Recovery
2.desc: Once per long rest, on a short rest recover slots totalling half your druid level (rounded up), none 6th or higher.

9.name: Circle Spells
9.desc: Always prepared spells tied to the land you chose (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, Underdark), gained at 3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th level.

6.name: Land's Stride
6.desc: Nonmagical difficult terrain and plants don't slow or hurt you; advantage on saves vs magical plants like Entangle.

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.desc: Immune to poison and disease; elementals and fey can't charm or frighten you.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.desc: Beasts and plants attacking you WIS save or must pick another target.

2.name: Combat Wild Shape
2.desc: Wild Shape as a bonus action; in beast form, bonus action to spend a slot and heal 1d8 per slot level.

2.name: Circle Forms
2.desc: Wild Shape into beasts of CR 1 from 2nd level, then CR of druid level / 3 from 6th.

6.name: Primal Strike
6.desc: Beast form attacks count as magical.

10.name: Elemental Wild Shape
10.desc: Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

2.name: Speech of the Woods
2.desc: Sylvan, and beasts understand you and you them.

2.name: Spirit Totem
2.desc: Bonus action: a 30 ft spirit aura for 1 min, movable 60 ft. Bear: temp HP and STR advantage; Hawk: reaction advantage on an attack; Unicorn: detection and extra healing. Once per short rest.

6.name: Mighty Summoner
6.desc: Beasts and fey you summon get +2 HP per Hit Die and magical natural weapons.

10.name: Guardian Spirit
10.desc: Your summoned beasts and fey ending a turn in the totem aura heal half your druid level.

14.name: Faithful Summons
14.desc: When dropped to 0 HP or incapacitated, four CR 2 beasts appear to protect you for 1 h (as a 9th-level Conjure Animals); once per long rest.

2.name: Circle Spells
2.desc: Chill Touch, then always prepared spores spells from 3rd level (also at 5th, 7th, 9th).

2.name: Halo of Spores
2.desc: Reaction: a creature within 10 ft CON save or 1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).

2.name: Symbiotic Entity
2.desc: Spend a Wild Shape use: 4 temp HP per druid level, Halo of Spores rolls twice, melee hits +1d6 necrotic, for 10 min or until the temp HP are gone.

6.name: Fungal Infestation
6.desc: Reaction: a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dying within 10 ft rises as a 1 HP zombie for 1 h; WIS mod uses per long rest.

10.name: Spreading Spores
10.desc: Bonus action while Symbiotic Entity is active: a 10 ft cube of spores within 30 ft deals Halo of Spores damage (CON save) for 1 min.

14.name: Fungal Body
14.desc: Can't be blinded, deafened, frightened or poisoned; crits on you are normal hits.

2.name: Star Map
2.desc: A focus that grants Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared, Guiding Bolt free prof-bonus times per long rest.

2.name: Starry Form
2.desc: Bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use for 10 min: Archer (bonus action ranged spell attack 1d8 + WIS radiant), Chalice (heal extra 1d8 + WIS when healing), or Dragon (INT/WIS checks and concentration count 10 minimum).

6.name: Cosmic Omen
6.desc: After a long rest roll: even gives reactions to add 1d6, odd to subtract 1d6, to a roll of a creature within 30 ft (prof bonus uses).

10.name: Twinkling Constellations
10.desc: Archer and Chalice deal 2d8, Dragon gives a 20 ft hover fly speed, and you can switch constellation each turn.

14.name: Full of Stars
14.desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing in Starry Form.

2.name: Circle Spells
2.desc: Always prepared wildfire spells at 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th level.

2.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
2.desc: Spend a Wild Shape use: a wildfire spirit appears within 30 ft (creatures within 10 ft DEX save or 2d6 fire) and fights for you for 1 h.

6.name: Enhanced Bond
6.desc: With the spirit out: +1d8 to one roll of your fire or healing spells, and spells can originate from the spirit.

10.name: Cauterizing Flames
10.desc: A creature dying near you or the spirit leaves a flame; reaction when someone enters it: heal or burn them 2d10 + WIS (prof bonus/long rest).

14.name: Blazing Revival
14.desc: When dropped to 0 HP with the spirit within 120 ft, it drops to 0 and you rise with half your HP; once per long rest.
